ShortDescription.Value: Better Transit Boarding. Late passengers stop holding up vehicles, and cims can RUN earlier to catch Buses, Trams, Trains, and Subways.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Better public transit boarding
Vanilla can keep a vehicle stuck boarding past departure time while it waits for passengers — even if they are still far away. Vanilla's fallback can still take ~10 minutes past scheduled departure time.
#### Better Boarding helps way before that by reducing late-passenger delays to keep transit moving and help vanilla un-bunch vehicles.
- Helps reduce transit delays, traffic backups, and vehicle bunching. - Especially useful in busy cities with lots of public transit. - ✅ Speeds up public transit boarding/loading with simple sliders. - ✅ Lets late cims miss a vehicle (if it's after departure time) so others are not held up. - ✅ Late cims can also start running sooner so they have a chance to catch their ride (bus + tram + train + subway).
### Skip Late Passengers - ✅ When **Skip Late** is enabled, late citizens who are still **not ready** even after **departure time** can miss that vehicle instead of making everyone wait. - The cim is not deleted and the game can naturally reassign them. - Groups/families are helped so one cim does not cause a long delay. This helps the vehicle leave instead of waiting up to 10 minutes for someone far away.
### Cims Run Sooner 🏃‍➡️🏃‍♀️‍➡️🏃‍♂️‍➡️ 🚍 Bus + Tram + Train + Subway
- ✅ When **Cims Run Sooner** is ON, the assigned but late passengers can start running a little sooner. - Vanilla starts cims running at departure time, which can be too late to help if they are not already at the stop/station. - Like real life, people start running from a block away, not just at the stop. - Helps reduce how many cims miss their ride and need to be reassigned. It does not change departure time, force boarding, or teleport citizens.
### Notes - **Compatibility:** should not use Better Boarding and All-Aboard at the same time - pick one. - Some players report no issues with Smart Transportation with Better Boarding. - Mod is intended to be a lighter, safer alternative than replacing the game's whole transport system files approach. - This mod works nicely with [All Transit + Trucks](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138390/Windows) to solve many transit issues. - Safe to remove anytime. No Harmony patches; lightweight design for low overhead.
### Support and feedback - Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right); helps people know about the mod. No donations requested. - Feedback on GitHub and Discord links (buttons on the right). PRs welcome.
### Credits and Thanks - River-Mochi - mod author - Inspiration and thanks to bcallender's All Aboard mod and Wayze's InstantBoarding. - yenyang (Anarchy) - code review/feedback and testing. - MayorCheeks, Empiiey, Neco1996, Gagaxm - testing - elGendo87 - Thumbnail straightener
### 15+ Languages Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, 你好, 안녕하세요, Olá, 你好, こんにちは, Cześć, สวัสดี, Xin chào, Merhaba, Привіт
### Bonus Status report
After the city runs a bit, check Options for current waits, worst stops, skipped passengers, and Run Sooner counts.
- If a stop has a huge wait, check it for traffic, bad placement, or too few vehicles. - [Stats to Log] writes a detailed one-time snapshot with stop names, Entity IDs, line hints, and more. - Stats to Log only runs when clicked; it is not a per-frame city system.
### How does it work?
Better Boarding leaves vanilla transport, departure scheduling, and un-bunching in control as they can work well with a little help. It mainly steps in when late passengers would otherwise keep boarding open too long and cause unnecessary delays.
**Solo late passengers** - If they are still too late, they can miss that vehicle; then we let vanilla naturally reroute them.
**Late groups/families** - Groups get a brief extra chance to board together. - If the leader remains outside, the whole group is released from that vehicle using vanilla methods. - If the leader is aboard, Better Boarding nudges the game's normal system to finish boarding the lagging child or pet.
**Run Sooner** - Vanilla already has cims start running at stops but not until departure time, which is often too late, especially on long platforms. - We allow assigned passengers to begin running 512 frames earlier (a few seconds). - Does not force boarding or change vehicle departure times.
**What does lightweight mean?** Better Boarding does not use Harmony patches or replace entire game transport systems. It works alongside and improves the game's normal systems. It is designed to have a low performance impact, even in large cities.
If you got this far, congrats, say hi, there is a senryu poem I wrote just for you in images. Click Like button, it's hard, I know, and so tiny.
